title: PIXL 8000 Hub Bub Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Hub Bub PIXL 8000 Prefilled Pod delivers a classic chewy confectionery-inspired flavour with a playful burst of fruity sweetness. Smooth, light and nostalgic, this blend offers an easy all-day vape with vibrant character. Each pod contains 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid designed for smooth, satisfying vapour. It connects seamlessly to the 10ml refill reservoir in the PIXL 8000 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit, automatically refilling the pod as you vape—providing up to 8000 puffs per kit with zero mess or refilling required. Mesh coil technology keeps the flavour clear and consistent, while the MTL draw makes for a comfortable, discreet experience.
